Austria / Seefeld in Tirol

Alpin Resort Sacher Seefeld

Sacher in the mountains. A resort at 1,200 m on the Seefeld plateau, set in its own 20,000 m² natural park, and part of Sacher Hotels since 2022. Innsbruck is half an hour away.

Enquire about this hotelAbout Seefeld in Tirol
01 / 06

In short

What to know.

  • 81 rooms and suites in six categories, from 30 to 95 m²; the Signature suites have their own sauna
  • A 4,700 m² wellness area with an infinity sports pool and a natural bathing lake with an alpine beach
  • The toque-awarded restaurant Der Max, and a piece of the original Sacher-Torte
  • 245 km of cross-country trails in the region, right from the plateau

Why we send guests here

Who it suits.

For a calm week of cross-country skiing, spa days and long dinners, with gentle slopes close by and Innsbruck for a day in town.

The Sacher Academy For Better Aging.

The hotel's own health programme: a personalised Healthy Longevity programme under medical direction, with diagnostics, treatments and nutrition planned around your stay.

A programme of the hotel, delivered by the hotel's physicians and therapists.

Good to know.

EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. The stay and the Academy programme are provided by Alpin Resort Sacher Seefeld, under the hotel's terms.
